correctness.rationale: Exhaustive 511-form unit-ideal test yields 144 smooth sections; all 804 qualifying two-dimensional spans are enumerated and 13 full group orbits certified. Four affine-chart pair/Jacobian unit ideals for all 13 representatives prove geometric transversality. Since intersection degree is eight, the extension-field zero-count inversions exhaust every Frobenius cycle. Computations were rerun from the exact included source files.

value.rationale: Natural arithmetic of genus-one pencils on a del Pezzo surface: the complete finite-field Bertini enumeration proves universal reducedness and exact closed-base-point degree spectra. It exhibits degree-eight single-closed-point pencils and distinguishes arithmetic base loci invisible to rational-basepoint counts. Structural and complete natural classification, not an arbitrary invariant slice.
